ShortDescription.Value: Adjust Taxi use and Traffic for Citizens, Tourists, or Commuters.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Taxi Traffic
Do you want more control of the many taxis creating traffic gridlock? Citizens can make smarter travel choices by reducing taxi use.
Background: I started this mod in 2025 but only shared with a few players as it's a bit of effort between what's good enough for me versus adding all the extras for public release (tooltips/languages/images/etc.). Several have asked me to release it so I finally dotted all the "i's" If it's not a bother, please click the Like 👍 button top right to help people know about the mod.
### Adjustable Settings - ✅ **Residents avoid taxis**, set the range for locals; 0% = normal taxi use | 100% = maximum avoid taxis - ✅ Features: **Commuters avoid taxis** and **Tourists avoid taxis** [x] toggles let you reduce taxi use for those groups too.
### What to expect - Taxi traffic drops after the city runs for a few minutes. - Existing taxis may still be visible briefly while active trips finish naturally (depends on the options picked). - Use **Game Defaults** to restore vanilla taxi choices (toggles off and Resident slider at 0%). - Safe to remove anytime. No Harmony based patching; less likely to break on game patch day. - Tip: to verify usage, check Options menu > mod Status, to see usage is going down after a city runs a little.
### Support and Feedback - Easiest way to support is click the LIKE 👍 button (top right). - For Feedback use Github or Discord links (icons on right side of page). PR's are welcome.
### Credits and Thanks - RiverMochi: mod author - Noel/Noel2 (of MapExt): testing - Winterqt (of Grass sprites): testing
- Thumbnail: Wikipedia Traffic Congestion, photo by joiseyshowaa from Freehold, NJ - World Class Traffic Jam 2, license CC BY-SA 2.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?curid=63542844
### How it works
- Taxi Traffic (TT) uses the game's own ignore taxis methods instead of shutting down the whole taxi system (easier + safer). - Some taxis may still remain. Active trips are allowed to finish naturally for game stability. Some systems may independently call taxis. - Removing taxi stands prevents taxis from parking there. - Fun Fact: if local taxi supply can't meet demand, the game can send in outside connection (OC) taxis for local requests. - Keeping some local taxi depots can reduce the calls for OC taxis when taxi use is still allowed (in Options menu). - In testing, with the slider full 100% + Commuter ON + Tourist ON, it also reduced OC taxi traffic because of reduced taxi requests. - Fun Fact: since game update 1.5.7, the moving-in/out cims that previously used taxis are now instant moved; the pets are teleported too. Even so, taxi management is still useful for all the other trips.
